teaser.en: A small tree with bright yellow inner bark, and one of two quite different trees that share one Digo name.
teaser.sw: Mti mdogo wenye gome la ndani la manjano angavu, na mmoja kati ya miti miwili tofauti kabisa inayoshiriki jina moja la Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wenye gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano inayong'ala, na mwenga wa mihi miiri tafwauti sana ambayo ina dzina mwenga ra Chidigo.

summary.en: Mng'andu is a small tree of the Ochna family with bright yellow inner bark. Digo speakers use the same name for Crossopteryx febrifuga.
summary.sw: Mng'andu ni mti mdogo wa familia ya Ochnaceae wenye gome la ndani la manjano angavu. Wadigo hutumia jina hilo hilo kwa Crossopteryx febrifuga.
summary.dg: *Mng'andu* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *Ochna* wenye gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano inayong'ala. Adigo anahumira dzina hiri hiri kpwa *Crossopteryx febrifuga*.

about.en:
*Mng'andu* is a small deciduous tree or shrub of the Ochna family. Its leaves are simple, glossy and finely toothed, with many fine parallel side veins. The small flowers are white to cream, and they are followed by small fleshy fruits that ripen from red to black on a red base, as in other members of the family. The inner bark and roots are a bright yellow.

Pakia's informants identified the plants named *mng'andu* from their leaves and stem.
about.sw:
*Mng'andu* ni mti mdogo au kichaka kinachopukutisha majani, wa familia ya Ochnaceae. Majani yake ni sahili, yanayong'aa na yenye meno madogo kwenye kingo, yenye mishipa mingi myembamba ya pembeni iliyo sambamba. Maua madogo ni meupe hadi ya rangi ya krimu, na baada yake huja matunda madogo yenye nyama yanayoiva kutoka mekundu hadi meusi juu ya kitako chekundu, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia hii. Gome la ndani na mizizi ni ya manjano angavu.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea inayoitwa *mng'andu* kwa majani na shina lake.
about.dg:
*Mng'andu* ni muhi mdide au chitsaka cha jamii ya *Ochna* ambacho makodzage ganagbwa chila mwaka. Makodzage ni gasigoganyika, ganayong'ala na genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na gana mishipa minji midide ya uphande inayolungana sawa-sawa. Maruwa madide ni mereru hadi ga rangi ya maziya, na chisha kunamera matunda madide genye nyama ganayoivwa kula kundu hadi maru, dzulu ya chitsako cha kundu, dza kpwa mimea yanjina ya jamii ihi. Gopha ra ndani na mizi ni ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaimanya mimea inayoihwa *mng'andu* kpwa makodza na kolo.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and dry forest and is found from East Africa south to Mozambique and South Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu, na unapatikana kuanzia Afrika Mashariki kusini hadi Msumbiji na Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pha pwani na kpwenye matsaka makavu, na unaphahikana kula Afrika ya mashariki hadi Msumbiji na Afrika ya Kusini.

uses.en: Elsewhere, in southern Africa, the yellow bark and roots are used as a dye and in traditional medicine and magic. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Kwingineko, kusini mwa Afrika, gome na mizizi yake ya manjano hutumika kama rangi ya kutia na katika dawa za asili na uganga. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Kpwenye tsi zanjina, kusini ya Afrika, gopha ra rangi ya mandano na mizi nkuhumirwa kuhendera rangi na dza muhaso wa chienyeji na wa uganga. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mng'andu* for two quite different trees: this one and *Crossopteryx febrifuga* of the coffee family. He gives no meaning for the name, and no other language shares it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kwa miti miwili tofauti kabisa: huu na *Crossopteryx febrifuga* wa familia ya mibuni. Hatoi maana ya jina hili, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayolitumia. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kpwa mihi miiri tafwauti sana: uhu na *Crossopteryx febrifuga* wa jamii ya kahawa. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

conservation.en: In South Africa, where it is very rare, it has been heavily harvested for traditional medicine.
conservation.sw: Nchini Afrika Kusini, ambako ni adimu sana, umevunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya dawa za asili.
conservation.dg: Afrika ya Kusini, ambako ni adimu sana, ukakatwa sana kpwa ajili ya muhaso wa chienyeji.

reason.en: Another tree of the coastal bush
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa vichaka vya pwani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa weruni wa pwani
